_comment: apps/web. This is the rule that makes client-error-monitor.yml retirable:
the same errors, grouped and symbolicated, minutes after they happen
rather than on an hourly cron that reads over a million log rows.
Do not retire that workflow on the strength of this file existing. The
workflow is fed by a second, vendor-less path (apps/web's fanout to
/api/client-errors) that keeps working when the provider chunk fails to
load at all - which is exactly the stale-tab-after-deploy case. Retire it
once this rule has been seen to fire, on purpose, per onlooker-k34.
regression_event for the reason api-faults.json gives (ONL-217).
SEEN TO DELIVER (ONL-49): an error forced on app.onlooker.dev/login at
2026-10-28T02:15:12Z opened ONLOOKER-WEB-2, the workflow fired at
02:15:37Z, and the issue_owners email reached a team member.
How to force one, because the obvious way does not work: an error
thrown from a bare setTimeout callback in the console carries only
Sentry's own wrapper as a named frame, so it groups with every other
error thrown that way. The first attempt joined ONLOOKER-WEB-1, an
earlier test archived until escalating, and no alert fired - which was
correct. Give the error a frame of its own: eval a named function with
a //# sourceURL and throw from that, and it opens a new issue.
